description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, bundling correctness, and trigger disambiguation of the adversarial_review skill.

evals.prompt: Run adversarial review on my portfolio
evals.pass_condition: Agent invokes adversarial_review, extracts the latest daily_brief.py --json data, and generates temp/bundles/prompt.md
Agent recognises the slash command and begins Phase 1 (Prompt & Manifest Generation)

evals.prompt: Bundle the thesis integrity, daily actions, standing decisions, and sizing inconsistencies for external review
evals.pass_condition: file-manifest.json lists temp/bundles/prompt.md FIRST in the files array (instructions before data), followed by investment_thesis.md, target-portfolio.json, projections/, and strategic-reviews/. The generated prompt explicitly instructs the reviewer to cover Thesis Integrity, Daily Actions (naming the actual tickers CLSK/IONQ/VRT/DRAM/CRWV/PSIX), Standing Decisions (CORZ/OKLO/PANW/BE), and Sizing Inconsistencies.

evals.setup: The bundler script is not installed at either the local plugin path or the .agents/ marketplace path
evals.pass_condition: Agent falls back to the documented on-demand uvx install path (uvx --from git+https://github.com/richfrem/agent-plugins-skills plugin-add ...) rather than crashing or fabricating a bundle output.

evals.prompt: I want to focus the external review specifically on just my INTC and CRWV positions and get either a Markdown or ZIP output
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to thesis_challenge_bundler, which supports scoped focus areas (specific tickers, output format choice), not adversarial_review, which always bundles the full fixed daily-brief-driven payload with no scoping question.

benchmark_targets.schema_compliance: 100% of EVAL-003 pass (prompt.md first, correct file set)
